Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for the business and occupation tax rate for vegetation management services using goats or sheep.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the business and occupation tax rate forproviding a vegetation management service by using goats or sheep; andadding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Upon every person engaging within this state in the business ofperforming a vegetative management service through the use of goats orsheep, as to such persons, the amount of the tax with respect to suchbusiness must be equal to the gross income of the business multipliedby the rate of 0.2904 percent. For the purposes of this section, "vegetative management service"means when an owner of goats or sheep provides these animals forcompensation for the purpose of clearing or controlling the vegetationon another person's land.
